name: hubspot
description: Search and update contacts, companies, deals, and tickets.

CLIENT_ID.title: HubSpot Client ID
CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Leave blank to use Grok's HubSpot app when it is available to you. To use your own, the OAuth Client ID from Development → MCP Auth Apps → your app.

CLIENT_SECRET.title: HubSpot Client Secret
CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Only needed with your own Client ID: the OAuth Client Secret from the same HubSpot MCP auth app.
